messages:
Emma (Partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a formal SI co-sell intake cadence. Idea: 72h claim window, SFDC custom field `si_partner_owner`, and a `marketplace_ready` tag to gate joint announcements. Pilot with 3 partners (Accord, Blueforge, Nimbus). Thoughts?

Raj (Field Ops): 72h seems reasonable. Q: what happens if two partners claim the same account within that window?

Maria (SI Lead): We need clear ROE (rules of engagement). Proposal: first-claim holds for 72h, but if another partner has an active opportunity (SFDC stage >= Proposal) they win. Otherwise revert to first-claim.

Tom (Sales): Also add revenue threshold override — named-account deals > $250k should trigger AE + ChannelOps arbitration (not auto-assign).

Emma (Partnerships): Good call on revenue override. So hierarchy: named-account override (AE escalation) -> active-opportunity > first-claim. We'll document.

Maria (SI Lead): For account mapping, recommend we use `Account.SI_Partner__c` (string) and `Account.SI_Claimed_At__c` (datetime). Sample SFDC update snippet: ```UPDATE Account SET SI_Partner__c = 'Blueforge', SI_Claimed_At__c = 2026-03-24T15:00Z WHERE Id = '001xx000003NGT0AAX'```

ChannelOpsBot: Playbook draft uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/si-co-sell-intake-draft (permissions: partners-read).

Raj (Field Ops): One more edge case: marketplace listing pre-announcements. If partner wants joint announcement on cloud marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP), require marketplace_ready tag plus a signed joint comms checklist (legal + security clearance). Otherwise block public announce.

Emma (Partnerships): Agreed. Add `marketplace_ready=true` and a checklist checkbox in the partner portal. Pilot rule: 1) claim window 72h 2) SFDC fields set 3) marketplace_ready for public announce 4) revenue override goes to AE/ChannelOps.

Tom (Sales): Who owns the pilot? I can coordinate with the three SIs for the first 6 weeks, but need someone to own ops side (SFDC updates, triage).

Maria (SI Lead): I'll own ops for the pilot (SFDC updates + weekly sweep). I'll set up a triage cadence: Mon/Wed quick sweeps, Fri reconciliation.

Emma (Partnerships): Awesome — Maria owns ops. Tom will lead partner outreach. Raj will document escalation flow in runbook. Action items: 
- Maria: create SFDC field templates + update rules by EOD Tue 
- Raj: add escalation flow + conflict resolution examples by Thu 
- Tom: pilot outreach kickoff w/ Accord, Blueforge, Nimbus by Fri 

Maria (SI Lead): noted. I'll post the field template here when ready.

Tom (Sales): :thumbsup: If we can get the portal checkbox in parallel that'd be great — reduces manual checks.

Emma (Partnerships): Will follow up with devex to add portal checkbox. If anyone sees blockers, ping #channelops and cc me. Thanks all — short standing on Thu 10am to lock the playbook. :calendar:
